system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: At 13:41:49 UTC, DC-HD-01 logged creation of the account it_helper, with omar.haddad as the subject.
At 13:41:56 UTC, DC-HD-01 logged adding it_helper to the group named Administrators; the event records omar.haddad as the subject and a target group SID ending in 512.
The creation and group-add events share SubjectLogonId 0xc5db44d, so the records associate both changes with the same subject logon session.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied sensor status reports a winsec and Sysmon collection outage on WS-BCARTER-01 from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC; endpoint activity on that host during the relevant period is therefore incomplete.
The records establish the subject username for the account changes but do not identify the originating host or the person operating that session.
claims_not_established: Whether the account creation and group addition were approved or part of an authorized change.
Whether omar.haddad personally initiated the changes, or whether the account was used or accessed afterward.
Whether the session associated with SubjectLogonId 0xc5db44d originated from an approved administration workstation.
Whether the account or its group membership was subsequently used for malicious activity.
additional_evidence_needed: Correlate DC-HD-01 logon session 0xc5db44d with logon, authentication, and source-host records.
Verify change approval and confirm with omar.haddad whether these account changes were authorized.
Collect or review authentication and group-membership events for it_helper after creation, including any interactive or remote logons.
Review available endpoint, remote-administration, and command-execution telemetry from WS-OHADDAD-01 and any other candidate source host.
